title: Boolean-Dependent Register Action
statement: Let $r$ be a work-tape index, let $d_D,d_L,d_B$ be states, and let $rd$ be either a Boolean symbol or blank. If $rd$ is false, the selected action writes true on tape $r$, moves that tape's head one cell right, and enters $d_D$. If $rd$ is true, it writes false on tape $r$, moves that head one cell right, and enters $d_L$. If $rd$ is blank, it writes nothing on tape $r$, moves that head one cell left, and enters $d_B$.
caveat: The referenced register-action construction is not included in the supplied definitions, so its tape, input-head, and output behavior cannot be fully confirmed.
